description: Generate random geographic coordinates that are uniform by surface area across the globe (points are not bunched at the poles). Returns latitude and longitude in decimal degrees. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/random-coordinates/

decimals.description: Decimal places for each coordinate, 2 to 6 (default 4)

quantity.description: How many points to generate, 1 to 100 (default 1)
